Id1.text: The Acharya Institute of Technology, located in Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore – 560090, in the state of Karnataka, India, is directed by Dr. G. P. Prabhukumar, and has the distinction of being a Technical Campus designated by the All India Council for Technical Education of Mumbai.

Id2.text: The campus address for the Acharya Institute of Technology is: Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore - 560090, in Karnataka state. All India Council for Technical Education, located in Mumbai, awarded the Institute with the status of Technical Campus. The Institute's director is Dr. G. P. Prabhukumar.

Id3.text: The All India Council for Technical Education was proud to give the Technical Campus status to the Acharya Institute of Technology located in Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore, Karnataka - 560090, whose director is Dr. G. P. Prabhukumar. All India Council for Technical Education is located in Mumbai.
